name: Battle 3: cavalry and archers
description: Iron Age. Our horsemen and archers against their spearmen, swordsmen and archers on a field 7 hexes apart. Test the charge after a run (spearmen stop it), riders breaking away and coming back (they lose only a quarter strike on leaving), archers that shoot only standing, and higher ground. Our scouts stand ahead of our line. People 1 holds (no AI).
